name: Kakan no Renkinjutsushi ~Atelier Life~
original_name: 花冠の錬金術師 ～アトリエライフ～
source:
Lilly is a chick alchemist. She runs around the kingdom in order to transmute the phantom medicine "Drops of Yggdrasil".
Refined items can be used in battle or equipped by allies.
There are four companions who help the protagonist.
Childhood friend Edward, young aristocrat Adonis, traveler Tesla, and wizard Narcissus.
Love may be born during the journey with them. And more relationships.
Now, why don't you become an alchemist and devote yourself to love and adventure?
